job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities




Position: AI Palantir Developer Digital Engineering (Senior)




Preferred candidate profile




Your Key Responsibilities

Palantir Platform Development

Design and implement solutions on Palantir Foundry and Palantir Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP).
Build, optimize, and maintain data pipelines, transformations, and reusable data products.
Develop and manage Ontology models, business objects, relationships, actions, and workflows.
Create operational and analytical applications using Workshop and other Palantir development capabilities.
Configure and implement enterprise data models, semantic layers, and knowledge graphs

AI & Agentic AI Development

Develop AI-powered solutions leveraging:
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
AI Agents and Multi-Agent Systems
Prompt Engineering
Semantic Search
Knowledge Graphs
Build intelligent workflows using Palantir AIP Agent Studio and automation frameworks.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

Act as a bridge between business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams.
Collaborate with cross-functional squads (architects, data scientists, designers, and product teams).
Provide technical leadership in engagements, influencing architecture and delivery direction.
Present value articulation, solution architecture, and outcomes to CXO and senior stakeholders.

Delivery & Leadership

Lead development workstreams in Agile environments.
Mentor junior developers and engineers.
Conduct code reviews and enforce engineering best practices.
Engage directly with client stakeholders to gather requirements and demonstrate solutions.
Support production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Soft Skills

Consulting excellence: Strong client engagement and storytelling skills with ability to influence senior stakeholders.
Outcome orientation: Focus on measurable business impact, not just technical output.
Architectural mindset: Ability to design modular, composable, scalable digital platforms.
Bias for action: Thrive in ambiguity with a build-first, iterate-fast mindset.
Leadership: Ability to guide teams, mentor engineers, and own delivery outcomes.

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

5+ years of software engineering, AI engineering, or data engineering experience.
2+ years of hands-on Palantir Foundry development experience.
Experience building enterprise-scale AI or analytics solutions.
Experience working in consulting or client-facing delivery environments.

Additional Qualifications

Experience with Palantir AIP Agent Builder.
Experience in digital twin, IoT, or industrial AI solutions. Enterprise projects involving AI Palantir squads, ontology creation, document intelligence, and operational automation indicate increasing demand for these capabilities.
Knowledge of Graph Databases and Knowledge Graph architectures.
Experience with Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar LLM platforms.
Familiarity with Responsible AI, Governance, and Security frameworks.
High adaptability in fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environments
